data.name: Mayameen
data.gender_notes: Mayameen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'm-y-n' which means 'water'. The name Mayameen symbolizes the gentle, soothing waves of the ocean, reminding us of the tranquility and peace that can be found in nature. In Islamic tradition, water is also a symbol of purification and renewal. The name Mayameen carries the meaning “Gentle Waves” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mayameen usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle waves and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name connects us to the spiritual aspect of water, emphasizing the importance of purification and renewal in our spiritual growth and self-reflection.
